method: candidate lines proposed by corridor detection; identity decided from printed address runs
why_not_one_block_off: PRINTED NAME: both plates letter this corridor 'AVENUE K' down the roadway I measured and print 70' in it (sheet 24 casings native 2101.0/2316.0, sheet 30 casings 2108.0/2320.5, both ~214 native px = 70 ft). HUNDRED-BLOCK BREAK: the corridor carries the 1000|1100 transition on the cross streets on BOTH plates. Sheet 24 (11th and 12th St faces): west of the line 1001 1003 1005 1007 1009 1011 | 1013 1015 1017 1019 1021 1023 and 1002-1024; east of it the runs begin 1101 1103 1105 1107 / 1102 1104 1106 1108. Sheet 30 (12th and 13th St faces): west of the line 1001-1011 | 1013-1023 and 1002-1024; east of it 1101 1103 1105 1107 1109 / 1102 1104 1106 1108 1110. The corridor's own frontage confirms the streets: 1001-1028 (10th-11th) and 1101-1128 (11th-12th) on sheet 24; 1201-1228 (12th-13th) and 1301-1322 (13th-14th) on sheet 30. ONE AVENUE WEST is Broadway - lettered 'AVE. J OR BROADWAY' and annotated 150' / '150 ft. wide.' on both plates - which carries the 900|1000 break: sheet 24 cand1 shows 901 903 ... 923 / 902 904 ... 924 west of it and 1001-1008 / 1002-1008 east of it; sheet 30 cand3 shows the same 900 block (blocks 192/193, University of St. Mary and Sacred Heart R.C. Church) west of it. It is also a visibly wider roadway (~305 native px against Ave K's 214). ONE AVENUE EAST is 'AVENUE L' (lettered on sheet 24 cand3 and sheet 30 cand1), with the whole 1100 block - 1101-1123 / 1102-1124, blocks 70/71 on sheet 24 and 72/73 on sheet 30 - lying between K and L; Ave L carries the 1100|1200 break. Neither alternative shows 1000|1100, so neither can be this line. SEAM: 12TH ST is sheet 24's south edge (its crops print '30' in the bottom margin) and sheet 30's north edge (its crops print '24' in the top margin). NOTE ON THE PROPOSED CANDIDATES (none is an avenue): sheet 24's 824 / 1808 / 2793 and sheet 30's 914 / 1862 / 2811 all land on lot lines inside block interiors. Sheet 24's 824 falls between street numbers 917 and 919 in the 900 block (the 20-ft alley there, dashed and labelled 6" W. PIPE / 20', is at native ~627); its 1808 falls between 1015 and 1017 in the 1000 block (alley at ~1630). Sheet 30's 1862 falls between 1015 and 1017 in the 1000 block (alley at ~1685). No avenue name and no hundred-block change across any of them. RECORDED DISAGREEMENT (why this control cannot be better than a few px): the two plates are drafted at slightly different scale across this span. Broadway's centre near the seam reads 1153.2 on sheet 24 and 1170.8 on sheet 30 (b-a = +17.6) while Ave K gives b-a = +4.0; the Broadway->Ave K span itself measures 1056.6 px on sheet 24 but 1043.0 px on sheet 30, a 1.3% difference (~4 ft on the ground), and the corridor widths differ in the same sense (Ave K 215 vs 212 px, the 1000-block width 799 vs 789 px). A single translation cannot satisfy both avenues. Ave K is reported rather than Broadway because its casings are crisp and reproduce to <=1.4 px on two independent crops per sheet, because its 70-ft roadway has a far better-defined centreline than Broadway's 150-ft boulevard, and because sheet 24's other x-control (pair_20_24_x) is also carried on Ave K, keeping the network on one corridor. Residual uncertainty on b-a should be taken as ~+/-7 px.
measurement_note: Native x = raster x of work/sheets/1912w/u<unit>.jpg (3327x3898), origin top-left. Value is the midpoint of the two block-face casing lines bounding the 70-ft Avenue K roadway, measured in the block row ADJACENT TO THE 12th St SEAM (sheet 24 y 2700-3400, centres 2208.2 -> 2209.5 drifting south, extrapolated to the seam y~3550: 2209.8; sheet 30 y 0-1100, centres 2213.7-2214.9, at the seam y~200: 2213.8). Sheet 24 carries a drafted skew of about +0.002 px per row (its Ave K reads 2205 near y1700 and 2209.5 near y3400), so the near-seam row matters: pair_20_24_x reads the same corridor as 2194.0 at sheet 24's NORTH (9th St) seam, and the profile between the two seams is continuous and monotone, which cross-checks both readings. Ruler-read values off the supplied crops (sheet_24_cand2 and cand3, sheet_30_cand1 and cand2) reproduce these to 1.0 px.
